cells.gaps: Two surveys disagree: FinScope 2023 puts adults using mobile money at 69%, and the newer Global Findex puts adults with an account at 50% in 2024. No survey found puts it at 53% or more.
cells.note: The newest survey, Global Findex 2025, puts adults with a financial account at 50% in 2024, a quarter or more but under 53%. It replaces FinScope 2023's 69% using mobile money, which had set stage 3.
